title: Operating in production
summary: After it ships: observability (platform and agent traces), model monitoring and drift, SLOs and on-call, debugging and postmortems, security and compliance, autoscaling and cost.
intro: This module covers what happens after a system ships. It starts with seeing what the system does, through logs, metrics and traces with OpenTelemetry and Prometheus and through agent traces, and with knowing when a model degrades. It then covers keeping it reliable with SLOs, on-call runbooks, debugging and postmortems, keeping it secure and compliant, including in regulated industries, and paying a sensible price for it through autoscaling and cost efficiency.
